text:
mira: FYI PR #432 eval CI started failing consistently on GHA self-hosted runners — matrix jobs time out on artifact upload and then shards stall.

gha-bot: Workflow run https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/actions/runs/987654321 failed — job: eval-matrix-quant, status: timed_out

alex: Saw the same. Buildkite runs look fine, only GHA self-hosted nodes show high IO wait during `actions/upload-artifact`.

chao: Confirmed. Concurrent uploads from the matrix are spiking /var/lib/docker IO, hitting disk throttling around ~300MB/s.

samir: Can we avoid `actions/upload-artifact` for heavy artifacts? Presigned S3 uploads would offload GH runner and reduce API pressure.

jess: For PR gating we really only need smoke evals. Heavy quant/benchmarks should be nightly. Let's shrink the PR matrix to reduce contention.

mira: Agree on both. Also we need to keep dashboard metrics stable — if PRs skip shards, alerts/percentile baselines need to tolerate sparser data.

alex: Two quick mitigations: add `concurrency` with `cancel-in-progress`, and route big artifacts off-runner. Not sure we can tweak upload-artifact chunking.

jess: Example PR workflow change:
```yaml
concurrency:
  group: eval-pr-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
strategy:
  matrix:
    model: [gpt-small, gpt-4ish]
    mode: [smoke]
```

chao: Also add `actions/cache` for model weights and `permissions: contents: read` so workers reuse downloads instead of hammering network.

samir: For nightly jobs we keep full `matrix` and have a step that uploads results directly to `s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/nightly/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/` using presigned URLs, then the dashboard pulls from S3.

eng-ci-bot: Created ticket EVALS-1123 to track: GHA runner artifact timeouts. Suggested fixes: presigned S3 uploads + split PR/nightly workflows. Assigned to @mira.

mira: I'll prototype a tiny presign/upload helper action and a GHA wrapper today. If anyone wants to pair, ping me :coffee: 

alex: I'll test a reduced matrix on a spare self-hosted runner this afternoon :eyes:
